title: Magic Conch
meta_description: Find the perfect Panama City Beach, FL vacation rental at Magic Conch, a luxury 8-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 26 guests, this home house offers all the luxury amenities Panama City Beach has to offer. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights • Convenient Beach Access Directly Across the Street • Expansive Private Outdoor Entertainment Area • Heated Pool & Hot Tub (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) • Outdoor Kitchen and Fire Pit • 6 seater Golf Cart & 6 adult Bikes • Game Room with Shuffleboard • Turf Putting Green • Private Elevator Welcome to your Panama City Beach coastal escape, an impressive eight-bedroom, three-story home designed for group getaways, effortless beach days, and unforgettable outdoor living. With Gulf views and convenient beach access directly across the street, this home places you just steps from the sugar-white sand while offering the space and privacy of a private retreat. Outdoor living takes center stage here. The expansive private entertainment area features a heated pool and hot tub, an outdoor kitchen, and a fire pit, creating the perfect setting for daytime lounging and relaxed evenings under the stars. For a little friendly competition, enjoy the turf putting green or gather for games and conversation around the pool. (Pool heat available for an additional $60 per day from October 1 through May 1.) Inside, the home is thoughtfully designed across three spacious levels, easily accessed by a private elevator, ideal for multi-generational groups. The open living areas offer plenty of room to gather, while the game room with shuffleboard provides a fun retreat for all ages after a day at the beach. Exploring Panama City Beach is effortless with a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes included, making it easy to cruise to the beach, local dining, or nearby attractions. Whether you’re watching the sunset over the Gulf, enjoying poolside afternoons, or gathering everyone together for evening fun, this home delivers the perfect blend of location, comfort, and coastal luxury for an elevated Panama City Beach vacation. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Two Full over Full Bunkroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Second Floor Two Twin over Twin Bunkroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only Third Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Two Twin over Twin Bunkroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only
